definition: A frozen-model external action benchmark that admits at least two genuinely new hidden mobility interventions only after source, spatial, action-semantic and target-seal evidence passes.
single_new_question: Can one model package frozen before any hidden-target access improve strong history and spatial baselines on at least two newly admitted actions while correct action semantics outperform every frozen corruption?

canonical_action_contract.reason_for_reduction_from_v5: Six identifiable action dimensions are used because V5 had only three training actions per fold for a fifteen-dimensional action vector.

runtime_r5.purpose: Execute the hidden set through a shared GWM Runtime Kernel profile rather than a benchmark-only model script.
runtime_r5.ensemble_rule: arithmetic mean in raw count space

evaluation.primary_error: equal-hidden-event macro pre-action-normalized MAE over stable spatial units, four targets and five reported horizons

paired_bootstrap.unit: stable spatial unit within hidden event
paired_bootstrap.event_aggregation: equal-weight mean over admitted hidden events

conditions: mean hidden-event skill over history AR is at least 1 percent
paired bootstrap interval for candidate minus history AR is entirely below zero
at least one of two hidden events improves by at least 1 percent
no hidden event degrades by more than 2 percent
at least 6 of 8 hidden-event-target pairs improve
at least 4 of 5 equal-event reported horizons improve
correct action beats no-action, history AR and fixed spatial AR in aggregate
correct action beats every frozen corruption in aggregate and no corruption wins both hidden events

benchmark_complete_when: the activation gate was satisfied before Runtime-R5 freeze
all admitted source and target-seal evidence is hash-bound
one model package predicts every hidden event before any hidden target access
all required models, controls and seeds emit complete submissions
all committed predictions replay within tolerance
the frozen evaluator publishes the full result regardless of model success
data previews, failures, hashes and claim boundaries are published

supports_if_completed: reproducible frozen-model evidence on the admitted new mobility actions
incremental action value over strong historical and spatial forecasts
Runtime-R5 target isolation, commitment and replay evidence
does_not_support_without_separate_eviden: cross-city generalization when no hidden external jurisdiction is admitted
complete universal GWM or DAM-GK validity

next_permitted_action: Screen candidate evidence only. Do not download outcome rows, train a V6 model, build Runtime-R5 formal predictions or access hidden targets until the activation gate passes.
